source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: record ranks and environment; verify process-group rendezvous; inspect topology and GPU visibility; run a minimal all-reduce; test interface selection and timeout; compare single-node and reduced-world runs.
corrected_answer:
Treat the hang as a symptom, not proof of an NCCL, network, or GPU fault. In an authorized disposable allocation, record launcher/framework/backend, versions, image, hosts, world size and placement; for every rank record global/local rank, PID, visible GPU, NIC/interface, rendezvous outcome, collective sequence, timestamps and last progress. Redact secrets and sensitive addresses. Verify expected versus observed rank sets, device mapping, store reachability, routes/MTU/firewall, container device access, GPU health, topology and clock/configuration consistency.

Falsifiable hypothesis: rank r is missing or using a non-reachable rendezvous/transport path, so peers wait at initialization; it is falsified if all ranks join with identical ordered collectives and a matched path test succeeds. Run a minimal deterministic all-reduce with a bounded watchdog and per-rank logs, first single-node, then a reduced world, then full world, randomizing trial order and holding image/configuration/workload constant. Measure join latency, first-progress time, completion, checksum, timeout, rank failure, transport errors and cleanup; compare denominators and logs. Test one authorized interface change at a time, never disable safety checks. Stop on timeout, clean children, preserve logs, and roll back only reversible changes.

Confounders include collective-order mismatch, stale workers, bad placement, topology/P2P incompatibility, driver/runtime mismatch, resource pressure, firewall/DNS, and transient fabric faults. Do not claim root cause without rank-level logs and repeated matched trials.
risks: A reduced-world pass can mask a rank-specific or topology-specific full-world failure.
Interface or timeout changes can alter symptoms without identifying root cause.
Logs may expose credentials, addresses, or private identifiers if not redacted.
evidence_required: Per-rank rendezvous and collective-order logs, expected/observed membership, device and interface mapping, version/configuration manifest, and repeated randomized results for single-node, reduced-world, and full-world trials.
